name: Memory
description: Curated persistent notes in MEMORY.md / USER.md (file-backed).

function.name: memory
function.description:
Save durable facts to persistent curated memory (Markdown under $TOMO_HOME). Entries are injected into future sessions, so keep them compact and high-signal.

WHEN — save proactively (do NOT wait for the user to say "remember" / "save this"):
- User states a preference, correction, or personal detail
- User corrects your style, tone, format, or verbosity
- You learn a stable fact about their environment, hostnames, conventions, or workflow
Priority: user preferences & corrections > environment facts > procedures. The best memory stops the user repeating themselves.

TARGETS:
- user → memories/USER.md — who the user is (name, role, prefs, communication style)
- memory → agents/<id>/MEMORY.md — your notes (env facts, conventions, tool quirks, lessons)

HOW: action=add|replace|remove|list. For replace/remove, pass old= a short unique substring of the existing entry. Writes hit disk immediately; the system-prompt snapshot refreshes next session.

SKIP: trivial/obvious info, easily re-discovered facts, raw dumps, task progress, completed-work logs, temporary TODOs, PR/issue numbers, commit SHAs, "Phase N done" — use session_search for those. Reusable procedures belong in manage_skill, not memory. Longer documents → remember/recall.

STYLE: write declarative facts, not self-instructions. "User prefers concise responses" ✓ — "Always respond concisely" ✗.

target.description: memory (agent notes) | user (shared profile) | project (workplace PROJECT.md) | all (list only)

content.description: Entry text for add (or new text for replace).

old.description: Unique substring identifying the entry for replace/remove.

agent_id.description: Defaults to the bound agent (for memory target).

workplace_id.description: Workplace id for project target (defaults from agent workplace).
